summary: Silicon Motion Technology Corp filed a Form 6-K on April 24, 2026, confirming its previously announced quarterly cash dividend of $0.50 per ADS ($0.125 per ordinary share) to be paid on May 21, 2026 to shareholders of record on May 7, 2026. The dividend is part of a $2.00 per ADS annual dividend declared by the Board on October 27, 2025, payable in four quarterly installments. This is a routine capital return event, not a special situation like a tender offer or going-private transaction. What to watch: no risk-arb angle; future dividends depend on Board's ongoing determination.
